facts.text: The resort is set along Al Aqah Beach with the Hajar Mountains behind it, overlooks the Indian Ocean and is around 90 minutes from Dubai.
facts.excerpt: Set along Al Aqah Beach with the Hajar Mountains behind it, InterContinental Fujairah Resort overlooks the Indian Ocean and is around 90 minutes away from Dubai.

facts.text: The resort is on a secluded stretch of Al Aqah Beach, where the shoreline opens wide to the Indian Ocean with the Hajar Mountains just beyond.
facts.excerpt: On a secluded stretch of Al Aqah Beach, the shoreline opens wide to the Indian Ocean, with the Hajar Mountains standing just beyond.

facts.text: Four temperature-controlled pools trace the coastline, including an infinity pool that stretches toward the Indian Ocean, family areas and a secluded Club pool.
facts.excerpt: Along the shores of Al Aqah Beach, four temperature-controlled pools trace the coastline. An infinity pool stretches toward the Indian Ocean, while family areas and a secluded Club pool create distinct moments

facts.text: Every room and suite opens to uninterrupted Indian Ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Every room and suite opens to uninterrupted Indian Ocean views

facts.text: Classic Rooms combine contemporary comfort with Arabian-inspired craftsmanship and have a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Classic Rooms combine contemporary comfort with Arabian-inspired craftsmanship. Relax on your private balcony

facts.text: Presidential Suites of up to 245 square meters offer private living and dining areas and panoramic terraces.
facts.excerpt: Expansive suites up to 245 sqm offer private living and dining areas, panoramic terraces

facts.text: O Spa by L'Occitane offers Provence-inspired wellness rituals and is the first L'Occitane spa in the Northern Emirates.
facts.excerpt: Discover Provence-inspired wellness rituals at the first L'Occitane spa in the Northern Emirates

facts.text: The spa has generous treatment areas, calming relaxation spaces and an open, airy design, framed by the Al Aqah coastline and Hajar Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Framed by the Al Aqah coastline and Hajar Mountains, generous treatment areas, calming relaxation spaces and an open, airy design create a sense of restoration and balance.

facts.text: Guests can begin the day with a guided yoga session beside the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Begin the day with a guided yoga session beside the Indian Ocean

facts.text: Planet Trekkers Kids Club offers supervised indoor and outdoor activities for younger guests, including arts and crafts, games, movies and reading areas.
facts.excerpt: Planet Trekkers Kids Club offers supervised indoor and outdoor activities for younger guests, including arts and crafts, games, movies and reading areas.

facts.text: Curated water experiences include snorkelling, paddleboarding and parasailing.
facts.excerpt: Explore the coastline through curated water experiences including snorkelling, paddleboarding and parasailing

facts.text: Snoopy Island is a haven for snorkelling, kayaking and swimming, with coral reefs home to marine life including rays and sea turtles.
facts.excerpt: Snoopy Island is a haven for snorkelling, kayaking and swimming. Its crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs are home to colourful marine life, including rays and sea turtles.

facts.text: Snoopy Island is about 6.5 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Snoopy Island - 4.04 miles away (6.5 kilometers)

facts.text: Club InterContinental offers exclusive lounge access, personalised service, curated culinary presentations throughout the day and dedicated check-in.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay with exclusive lounge access, personalised service and curated culinary presentations throughout the day. Enjoy refined privacy, dedicated check-in

facts.text: NAMA Global Dining is the resort's main restaurant, offering all-day dining with international flavours in an ocean-facing setting.
facts.excerpt: As the resort’s main restaurant, NAMA Global Dining offers all-day dining with international flavours, from a generous breakfast buffet to à la carte lunch and dinner, in an ocean-facing setting.

facts.text: DRiFT Seafood Kitchen & Bar is the resort's beachside seafood restaurant, offering fresh seafood and prime cuts in an ocean-facing setting.
facts.excerpt: DRiFT Seafood Kitchen & Bar is the resort’s main seafood restaurant, offering fresh seafood, prime cuts and more, complemented by a relaxed ocean-facing setting

facts.text: A bespoke beachfront dining experience beneath the night sky is offered, with personalised menus, for proposals, anniversaries and intimate celebrations.
facts.excerpt: A bespoke beachfront dining experience set beneath the night sky. Ideal for proposals, anniversaries and intimate celebrations with personalised menus and dedicated service.
